FAQs
----

**Frequently Asked Questions**

  

Find answers to common questions by **clicking below**.

---

![](http://www.cityofkittitas.com/images/menu_list.png) [**Do I need a business license in Kittitas?**](javascript:showonlyonev2('newboxes1-2');)

If you have a business or are planning to do business within the city limits of Kittitas for profit or gain, you are required to [obtain a business license](https://dor.wa.gov/manage-business/city-license-endorsements/kittitas) and renew it annually. This includes, but is not limited to shops and home based businesses. A business license is easily obtainable for a nominal fee by visiting City Hall. See ***Title 5 - Business Licenses and Regulations*** of the  [**Kittitas Municipal Code**](http://www.cityofkittitas.com/code.html).

![](http://www.cityofkittitas.com/images/menu_list.png) [**How do I connect or disconnect utilities?**](javascript:showonlyonev2('newboxes2-2');)

**Electrical Service** is handled by either:  
Puget Sound Energy (PSE). Their customer service number is 1-888-225-5773.  
Or  
PUD. Their phone number is (509) 933-7200.

**Water & Sewer** hookups and disconnects can only be performed Mon - Thur between 8am - 6pm (Closed Friday), and must be handled in person at City Hall.

![](http://www.cityofkittitas.com/images/menu_list.png) [**How can I pay my Water/Sewer bill?**](javascript:showonlyonev2('newboxes3-2');)

**Online** - by clicking the *Online Bill Pay* box at the top of this site or visiting  [**Official Payments**](https://www.officialpayments.com/index.jsp?) website.

**In person** - at City Hall - We accept cash, check, money order or credit card\*. (A fee will apply for credit card transactions)

**By Drop Box** - located directly outside the front door of City Hall.

![](http://www.cityofkittitas.com/images/menu_list.png) [**Am I required to license my dog?**](javascript:showonlyonev2('newboxes4-2');)

**Yes**. The City requires proof of current rabies vaccinations and that dogs be licensed annually. Additional information regarding dogs and other animals can be found under ***Title 6 - Animals*** of the  [**Kittitas Municipal Code**](http://www.cityofkittitas.com/code.html).
